about: Slanting Cut (katana.k_1l1), the one-handed string's hit 1 (KE task 11): Attack1H02_R's diagonal cut down from high on the right to low on the left, one-handed as the pack keys it, in Elden Ring's rhythm: a wide wind-up over the right shoulder (source frames 0-8 over 9), the cocked pose held, the strike snapped through in a frame and a half into the active frames, the follow-through held low on the left, then back to the guard. The blade starts and ends 45 degrees lower, as the one-handed guard carries it, and rides the clip's own aim from the cocked pose to the follow-through. The blade is turned on where it would pass within 12 cm of the body (the return to the low guard past the thigh; the game's bodies are fuller than the rig's capsules). A step forward (okuri-ashi) carries the body into the cut. Source frames at 30 fps from 0.
